items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I played clarinet on the record. Lloyd Reese (PHONETIC) played trumpet. Oscar Bradley (PHONETIC) played drums.

ctx.x: Well, it was one -- I played clarinet on the record. Lloyd Reese (PHONETIC) played trumpet. Oscar Bradley (PHONETIC) played drums. Can't think who played bass. That was about it. And Art Tatum played piano. Can't think -- Red Callender, I think, played bass.
Do you know what you recorded? (Inaudible)?
